storage: append-only JSONL day-files <archive>/flight_events/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl (UTC day of the event)
written_by: server/flightPlans.ts appendFlightEvent (DeviationTracker events for aircraft whose plan was requested via GET /api/data/aircraft/plan/:hex; SWIM amendments for tracked callsigns)
source: derived: our ADS-B position archive (adsb.lol primary) evaluated against the flight's plan — FAA SWIM SFDPS filed plan when configured, else the adsb.lol route DB (Virtual Radar Server standing data, CC0) or the callsign's last recorded trip in our own archive
license: derived work over ODbL 1.0 positions (adsb.lol) + CC0 route data + US-government FAA SWIM data; attribution 'adsb.lol' carried
attribution: adsb.lol; Virtual Radar Server standing data (CC0); FAA SWIM SFDPS

field_map.t: event time, ms epoch (the fix time that triggered it)
field_map.detail: one-line human-readable reason (thresholds, rejoin point, amendment diff)
field_map.src: plan source the event was judged against: FILED_FAA | HISTORY_PREDICTED | ROUTE_DB_PREDICTED
field_map.xt: cross-track distance to the plan in nm at the event (null when unknown)
field_map.la: latitude of the triggering fix (null for amendments)
field_map.lo: longitude of the triggering fix (null for amendments)

confidence_model: RAW-derived operational events, NOT incidents. A deviation is > 8 nm cross-track for 3 consecutive en-route fixes (terminal areas within 40 nm of either end excluded; fix spacing 30s-5min makes tighter thresholds noise), ending when < 4 nm. When the plan is PREDICTED (route DB great circle or last trip's path) a 'deviation' may be the prediction's error, not the aircraft's — the src field says which. Only aircraft whose plan was requested are evaluated, so absence of an event is not evidence of on-plan flight.
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04). FLIGHT PROGRAM playback support: the real flown path stays the aircraft archive (truth); this stream records when an aircraft left and rejoined its plan so a replay can show it.
